evidence_summary: Replay log shows create with metricType="" returning 200/code=0 and create with consistencyLevel="None" returning 200/code=0, while dimension=32769 is correctly rejected with code=65535 and a clear range message.
rationale: metricType="" and consistencyLevel="None" are out-of-enum values barred by type_constraints milvus_type_collections_create_002/003 (both keyword-matched) and by behavioral_collections_create_002 (400 on invalid parameters), yet two independent repros show them accepted with success (200/code=0) — a clear, reproducible Type1 illegal-success; c3 shows range validation works, so the gap is specific to enum validation, and no maintainer by-design note in the material covers these consumed top-level params (50351 covers only unconsumed fields like top-level shardsNum).
